name: Top Performers Breakdown
subtitle: The pattern your best posts share, and the shape to write more of.
summary: Ranks your top posts over a window and reads what they have in common (topic, format, hook style), then spells the pattern out as a shape you can write more of. Nothing is applied to your drafts automatically.
howToAsk: What were my best posts this month?
Find the pattern in my winners.
provide: optionally a window (up to 90 days, otherwise the last 30).
get: the ranked winners, the shared pattern, and next-step suggestions.
chips: Synced numbers lag a few hours
launchPrompt: Show my top posts from the last 30 days and break down the pattern behind them.
